reviewer: Codex independent source reviewer, separate from corpus author and provider

findings.detail: Some project summaries tell the evaluator a defect exists or prime the expected source-evidence boundary. quote.summary is included in provider scopeContext by lib/delivery-assessment.ts. Bilingual summary says one language is inconsistent; hire summary says the copy distinguishes the prices; image/mobile summary prescribes direct observation; source-instruction summary warns about the exact attack. Replace all summaries with neutral buyer scope and keep universal limitations only in the common assessment policy.

The tour criterion requires at least 48 hours but delivery says no later than two days. Calendar-day versus elapsed-hour readings make a strict supported reference debatable. Use an unambiguous equivalent hours phrase while retaining the fee-return paraphrase.

priorCorpusOverlap.method: Exact complete string comparison of every new criterion.source and every file content against all recursively collected string values in three retained prior corpora. This is a duplicate check, not a proof of semantic novelty.

corpusIndependenceLimits: All 12 are newly authored synthetic multi-file fixtures, not external websites, customers, participants, or human usability research.
Fixtures reuse a shell and the same CSS; they do not establish coverage across independent technology stacks.
There are 39 files with 28 unique full contents. Shared CSS contributes deliberate repeated content.
No prompts may be tuned on these outcomes and then the same corpus reused as unseen evaluation evidence.
providerIsolationRequirements: Do not send reference labels, rationales, relevantFiles, stratum, project IDs containing result terms, or benchmark category to provider.
Use deterministic neutral project/delivery IDs; criterion ids manual-1 and manual-2 must be joined by projectId plus criterionId for scoring.
Only buyer scope, criteria, actual rule evidence and actual source-packet coverage may inform assessment.
validationBoundary: This audit inspects source/reference semantics only. It makes no claim about provider results, browser execution, payment, deployment, or human research.

fixtureStructureValidation.method: Actual production validateStaticFiles for all project file maps; decodeRasterDataUrl for poster.png using the existing strict PNG chunk/CRC validator. No provider or network calls.
fixtureStructureValidation.scope: Valid file format is not semantic image quality or browser/runtime execution.
